heads.en: Hwang In-hoon borrows money to make SMS crazy! The Bureau of Criminal Affairs warns: Don't go back to Hwang In-hoon, Executive Director of NVIDIA, who announced his resignation on the 12th day of the affair, and who recently sent an absurd SMS intercept on the Internet, claiming to have been framed by the U.S. government, needs a million dollars to return to his position as CEO, and promised "to design RTX6090 cards in your name."
